request: Remove the URL-bearing web video preview page; enter fullscreen directly and retain portrait/landscape fullscreen, episodes and close
constraints: preserve audio/local-file preview behavior unless needed by this web-video request
implementation: Direct fullscreen entry for web video; close ends playback; no URL-bearing intermediate page.
Portrait and landscape fullscreen share the same decoder and use a logical-canvas fallback for iPad windows.
Loading/error overlays do not consume timeline layout; time and slider moved down eight points without shifting the bottom action row.
Unknown duration shows an empty disabled timeline instead of 100 percent.
Video tool handoff always applies, regardless of the automatic embedded-player takeover switch.
Selecting an episode immediately closes its drawer and uses the centered loading indicator; failure reopens the drawer with retry.
